Name: Bring weapon components to Adri
Summary: Adri Afeli dabbles with weapons technology and has found a way to increase the output of some simple weapons. He has uploaded a list of five items he's looking for. As a reward for your hard work, he will give you a better weapon of your choice. The list he gave you is: Power Supply (Cargo Droid), Compression Chamber (Waste Collector), Bone Plates (Cliff Malle), Stalker Limbs (Tropical Stalker), Rollerrat Intestines (Rollerrat), a basic weapon. If you don't have a weapon, you can buy one from Antonio Stacklund.
